name: ZICHIS

rows.label: Non-current Assets
rows.source: Zichis Agro-Allied Industries Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, statement of financial position, printed page 34 (file _ngx_pdf/ZICHIS.pdf); NGN. Non-current assets 741,396,207 (2024: 704,529,529); total current assets 484,318,426 (152,746,365); total equity 1,171,654,602 (833,591,751); total current liabilities 54,060,031 (23,684,143). No non-current liability line is printed. For 2024 the sheet prints total assets 867,276,894 while its own components sum to 857,275,894; the figure already stored (857,275,894) is the component sum and the split here ties to it, so the printed total is the internal inconsistency.
